Generic detector (audit 2026-10-28): Guide-to-Pharmacology records whose gene list holds 3 or more symbols from the first 8 percent of the DGIdb alphabetical symbol list (A12M3, A1BG, AAMP, AARS1, ABAT, ABCA1 ...) carry an upstream expansion to the alphabetically earliest genes (adenosine, pergolide, fluphenazine ...). A row on such a symbol without a second source does not count. The explicit ABAT/ABCA rows above also cover the 22 ABAT-only records that the run test cannot see (fewer than 3 early symbols)
